resources.string: A warning light, or a page of the service booklet
From 3 photos, a 3D model or a file
Plate, VIN and first registration for the car
In any app, share a place or some text with Send to car: the place becomes the car\'s destination, the text is typed on its screen.
The phone in its holder behind the windscreen watches the road.
Nothing to allow yet: once the car is paired, Settings asks for what it needs.
